name: corpoapi
description: Find and retrieve company registry records, officers, ownership and verification with names, numbers and official register data.

interface.longDescription:
Get company registry records in ChatGPT. Search companies, verify a business, and check its directors, shareholders, ownership chain, company links, filings, financial statements and EU VAT number.

Covers official company registers in more than 30 countries, including the UK, France, Sweden, Norway, Spain, Brazil, Canada and Japan, plus all 50 US states.

Ask a question and CorpoAPI finds the data, with names, numbers and official register records.

Connect your CorpoAPI account to get started. Setup instructions: https://corpoapi.com/mcp.
defaultPrompt: Find the Swedish company Klarna and show its registration number, status and address.
Show Acme Studio Ltd's directors and shareholders.
Verify that this UK company matches its registration number.

positive.description: Find a Swedish company and read its register profile
positive.prompt: Find the Swedish company Klarna Bank AB and show its registration number, status, legal form and registered address.
positive.expected_behavior: Klarna Bank AB with Swedish organisation number 5567370431, status active, its legal form and registered address.

positive.description: List a company's directors and officers
positive.prompt: Who are the current board members and CEO of Equinor ASA in Norway?
positive.expected_behavior: Equinor ASA (Norwegian organisation number 923609016) with its current officers from the Norwegian register, each with name, role and start date, including Anders Opedal as CEO (daglig leder).

positive.prompt: Show the financial statements Equinor ASA filed for 2025 in Norway, with currency and accounting standard.
positive.expected_behavior: The 2025 statements for Equinor ASA (923609016), consolidated and standalone, each with period 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31, currency USD and accounting standard. Missing amounts are shown as unavailable, not zero.

positive.description: Show who owns or controls a company
positive.prompt: Who owns or controls Monzo Bank Limited in the UK?
positive.expected_behavior: Monzo Bank Limited (UK company 09446231) with its persons with significant control from Companies House, including Monzo Bank Holding Group Limited (14785367) in the 75-100% ownership band. Bands are shown as ranges, never as exact percentages.

positive.description: Verify company details against the register
positive.prompt: Verify that UK company number 00445790 is Tesco PLC and that it is active.
positive.expected_behavior: A verified verdict for TESCO PLC (00445790): the name and active status both match the Companies House record, with each compared field listed and the registered address in Welwyn Garden City.

negative.description: Explain a compliance concept without looking up data
negative.prompt: What is the difference between KYB and KYC?
negative.expected_behavior: Explain the difference without calling CorpoAPI.

negative.description: Draft text that needs no company lookup
negative.prompt: Write a short email asking a new supplier to send their certificate of incorporation.
negative.expected_behavior: Draft the email without calling CorpoAPI.

negative.prompt: Upgrade my CorpoAPI plan and charge my saved card.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin is read-only and cannot change plans or billing, without calling CorpoAPI.

publication.release_notes: Initial release of CorpoAPI for ChatGPT, with company search, company profiles, officers, shareholders, ownership links, documents, financial statements, company verification and EU VAT checks.
